:notebook: *known issue recurrence* -- `ki-2026-07-03-ms-scheduler-api-seriesid-negative-recordid`
This is occurrence #139 (chronic, 14+ days running).
Owning team (would tag -- not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@customer-management` / `#team-customer-management`)
Playbook: 1) Confirm shape: DD monitor 303750093 in Alert/Warn or recently-recovered state (note: this monitor rotated from 303056222 on 2026-07-08 and was re-tuned to critical:5%/warning:3%, up from 2%). 2) Compute the error-rate ratio (errors/hits over the alert's own last_10m window) -- historically marginal, do not over-escalate on monitor state alone. 3) Root cause is a code-level missing-guard bug in SeriesDataProvider.GetSeriesIdAsync (not account-specific) -- reproduces across many accounts (12+ distinct so far, though this occurrence reverted to solely lafittesseafood). 4) File/bump a defect for CRM Experience rather than re-diagnosing from scratch each cycle.
Open Jira: none

Source alerts (1 total):
  - n/a -- degraded cycle, no Slack MCP this session; DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/303750093 (12:06 UTC)

Evidence:
  - DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/303750093 (OK, self-recovered by scan time; monitor ID rotated from 303056222, re-tuned to [P1]/critical:5%/warning:3%)
  - DD metric: 11 errors / 288 hits over 11:47:10-11:57:10Z (the eval window containing the burst) = 3.81% -- crossed the new 3% warning threshold, stayed under the new 5% critical threshold
  - Kibana: https://logstash.method.me/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:'2026-07-10T11:47:10Z',to:'2026-07-10T11:57:10Z'))&_a=(query:(language:kuery,query:'fields.dd_service.keyword%3A%22ms-scheduler-api%22')) -- 11 hits confirmed via raw search this cycle (KB's declared aggregate query on fields.Error.keyword still 0-bucket, documented field-name mismatch)
  - This-window concentration: lafittesseafood 11 (100% -- reverted to single-account shape this occurrence)

Note: last_notified_at was 2026-07-08T12:14:41Z (~47h54m ago) -- exceeds the 24h suppression window, posting per the window-expiry gate. Full writeup: docs/investigations/2026-07-10-3f733fb911aeeab7.md

Full investigation: docs/investigations/2026-07-10-771f0080a1d89e0f.md

:notebook: *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`
This is occurrence #569 (chronic pattern, first_seen 2026-05-20).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin` (`@admin` / `#team-admin`)
Playbook: Confirm chronic baseline (ES Ocelot warning volume vs 24h-ago) → aggregate timeouts by RequestPath (upstream microservices.methodlocal.int) → check ki-dns-microservices-method-int-pps-quota first (DNS bursts present as Ocelot timeouts) → identify slow downstream via ms-gateway-api Ocelot config → fix options: raise per-route timeout (cheap/masks symptom), scale microservices IIS pool (medium), or profile upstream service under load (root-cause, expensive).
Open Jira: n/a (none filed)

Source alerts: n/a — degraded cycle, no Slack MCP read access this session. Source: DD monitor 77419271, synthetic fire time 2026-07-10T19:28:12Z (self-recovered by scan time).

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/77419271 (state: OK at scan time)
  • DD logs: https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=Unusual%20number%20of%20XHR%20errors%20for%20account&from_ts=1783793592000&to_ts=1783794492000&live=false
  • Kibana: https://logstash.method.me/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:'2026-07-10T19:13:12Z',to:'2026-07-10T19:28:12Z'))&_a=(query:(language:kuery,query:'Exception.keyword:*TimedOut* OR message:*Ocelot* OR message:*ResponderMiddleware*'))
  • This-window concentration: gateway 109 (221 hits total, 2026-07-10T19:13:12Z–19:28:12Z)

Note: this recurrence resurfaces after 24h+ of suppression (last posted 2026-07-09T20:06:11Z) — routine resurfacing of a known chronic pattern, not a new incident. fix_status remains chronic-residual-post-rollback-2026-06-05, unaddressed.
